name: Out-of-body (right angular gyrus / TPJ)
summary: Murphy's 'altered states' order (both sides, then right only) with a 7 Hz 'hippocampal' theta signal stepping around the right-side coils, weighted to CP6/TP8 over the right angular gyrus, where Blanke 2002 evoked OBEs with electrodes. Lie down; Murphy reports most OBEs during sleep about 1 h after a session, best 00:00-04:00.
source: Murphy, Deja vu lecture https://youtu.be/KJIAHHB8Btk?t=4271 ; https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/rotating/shakti_obe.htm ; Blanke et al. 2002, Nature 419:269
